purpose: Acquire one exact official floor3_2 archive as opaque recoverable transport before any ZIP, geometry, RGB or algorithm access.

selection.selection_rule: Choose the lexicographically next official run after the already accessed floor3_1 from the frozen floor3_1/floor3_2/floor3_3 universe.

allowed: HEAD to the exact canonical URL for current transport metadata.
GET and byte-range continuation requests to the exact canonical URL only.
Automatic retry or resume for the same URL, file ID and partial path.
Streaming opaque bytes to a .part file.
Final byte-count, official-MD5 and local-SHA256 verification.
forbidden: Opening ZIP central-directory or any member before exact bytes and official MD5 pass.
Mirror, repack, floor3_3, CoRBS, KITTI-360 or other source fallback.
Using transfer behavior to change candidate selection.
RGB, depth, pose, geometry or algorithm outcome access before a separately frozen scientific contract and implementation lock.
transport_contract.cache_finalization: Rename the .part file to floor3_2.zip only after exact bytes and MD5 pass, then write an exclusive transport receipt with local SHA-256.

authority.reason: Prior floor3_1 payload and geometry access burned the complete CID-SIMS Floor3 capture family for confirmation; floor3_2 remains usable only under a new non-R2 development protocol.
